questions.stem: Why does the egg cell membrane change after the first sperm has entered?

options.text: To allow more sperm to enter for faster development
To prevent any other sperm from entering
To release hormones that signal pregnancy
To begin the process of cell division

questions.explanation: After the first sperm enters the egg, the egg membrane changes to become impenetrable. This prevents polyspermy (more than one sperm fertilising the egg), which would give the zygote too many chromosomes.
